author: Russell Brand
description:
Sonia Elijah argues that one of the biggest unanswered questions from the Covid era isn't where the virus came from, but whether the vaccines that reached the public were ever properly tested. Drawing on FDA documents, manufacturing records, and interviews with independent scientists, she examines claims about DNA contamination, changes to Pfizer's production process, and why she believes these issues deserve far greater scrutiny.

title: This is getting ugly…

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reflects on a visit to a pearl farm, learning that a pearl only forms because of an irritant, a piece of grit or a foreign object the oyster can't remove, that triggers it to secrete layer upon layer of beauty around the very thing bothering it. He connects that directly to how we handle pain, wondering whether we should be asking God to simply remove our obstacles and wounds, or asking him to help us create something beautiful from them instead. The idea isn't that the hurt disappears, but that it becomes encapsulated into who we become, the redeemed, reborn version of ourselves. A quietly powerful reframe on why the hardest things in your life might be shaping you rather than breaking you.
